Product Features
Classic christmas tree: Crafted with 3834 PE and PVC branch tips, this 7ft Christmas tree delivers a lush, full-bodied look. The dense needle design holds ornaments securely without a sparse look, creating an authentic forest centre for your seasonal displays.
Automatic hinged setup: Featuring a sectioned trunk with pre-attached hinged branch tips that drop down automatically, this Christmas tree allows less time in shaping and more time enjoying the holidays (suggested shaping time: 30-50 minutes). The sectional build ensures compact off-season storage.
Flame-retardant branch tips: Flame-retardant PE and PVC branch tips help slow the spread of fire, offering added reassurance for seasonal decorating. Your family and pets can gather around this artificial Christmas tree and enjoy a warm, cosy holiday season.
Solid fir wood base: Supported by a solid fir wood base, this artificial Christmas tree maintains firm balance against accidental knocks. The authentic wood effect texture elevates your home decor beyond basic metal stands, combining reliable stability with a warm rustic aesthetic.
Festive Accent for Versatile Layouts: With a compact 130 cm footprint, this artificial Christmas tree fits into living rooms, offices, or retail foyers. It creates a vibrant holiday backdrop for gift exchanges, family photos and winter parties without overcrowding your floor space.

7984723696876.sourceDescription:
Bring playful Christmas cheer to your holiday decorating!
This mini tabletop Christmas tree combines seasonal greenery, cheerful Santa details, and inviting illumination in a compact format that brings personality to your festive arrangement. Standing 90 cm tall, the artificial Xmas tree features 86 verdant branch tips for plentiful greenery, complemented by a plaid hat, soft white beard, and matching Santa-style boots. 20 warm white LED lights brighten the foliage, while 8 lighting modes (combination, in waves, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, fade, twinkle/flash, steady on) provide multiple effects for changing the ambiance throughout the season. With battery operation, the lighting is not restricted by a nearby outlet, and the integrated timer automatically follows a 6-hour on/18-hour off cycle. Premium PVC foliage offers flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic properties for added reassurance around children and pets. At the bottom, cement-filled black boots provide weighted support to maintain a steady position while carrying the Santa theme through to the base. Compact and easy to reposition, this small realistic Christmas tree fits neatly on entry tables, mantels, office desks, and other limited surfaces.
Note: Battery box requires 3 AA batteries, not included.
Note: The decorations are not included.
90 cm tabletop size provides a compact format for flexible seasonal placement
86 branch tips form abundant greenery with a full and dimensional profile
Santa-inspired design captures a playful, festive holiday character
20 warm white LED lights provide gentle brightness

Product Description

 This Christmas tree collar is made of soft plush fabric with silver snowflake embroidery, adding a warm and luxurious touch to your holiday tree.
 The fluffy white surface and delicate silver snowflakes create a sparkling winter atmosphere, while the conical shape neatly covers the tree stand and lower part of the tree.

 The tree collar is reusable and suitable for indoor use. Its elegant silver and white color complements white lights, silver ornaments, and winter themed decorations.
 Perfect for decorating your living room, fireplace area, shop window, school stage, Christmas party or wedding venue.

8635560241376.baseName: 1 Pack 90 x 45 cm Christmas Tree Skirt, Soft Velvet Base Cover with Centre Cut Out, Red
8635560241376.variantName: 1 Pack 90 x 45 cm Christmas Tree Skirt, Soft Velvet Base Cover with Centre Cut Out, Red
8635560241376.sourceDescription:
Finish the base of a Christmas tree properly with this deep red velvet skirt, which hides the stand, catches fallen needles and gives the pile of presents somewhere to sit.

The skirt is cut with a centre opening rather than a closed ring, so it slips around the trunk of a tree that is already standing and decorated. There is no need to lift the tree, dismantle the lights or take the star off the top, which is exactly the sort of job nobody wants to do in mid December.

Velvet gives the piece its weight and its look. The pile catches the tree lights softly instead of reflecting them like a synthetic sheet, and the fabric drapes in neat layered folds around the base, holding a full shape rather than collapsing into a puddle. The deep red sits well against green foliage, gold baubles and warm white lights.

At 90 x 45 cm it covers the stand and spreads well beyond it, hiding cables and the water reservoir of a real tree and protecting a wooden floor or carpet from drips and resin. A decorative bow at the opening finishes the look and disguises the join.

Fitting takes a moment: lay the skirt flat, slide the opening around the trunk, spread the folds evenly and tie or tuck the opening closed. After Twelfth Night, fold it away flat with the rest of the decorations, and it will come out looking the same next year.

Because the skirt is generous, it also protects a wooden floor from the water bowl of a real tree and hides the extension lead for the lights. The velvet is soft enough to sit under wrapped presents without scratching the paper, and the deep colour does not show dust between Christmases. The opening can be tied closed with the attached bow so the skirt stays in place when the room is vacuumed.

Wipe or brush the velvet clean and store it away from damp. One pack contains one tree skirt.
Centre Cut Out Fit: The opening slips around the trunk of a tree that is already decorated, so there is no need to lift it or unwire the lights at any point
Soft Velvet Drape: The pile catches tree lights gently and holds neat layered folds around the base instead of collapsing into a creased puddle
90 x 45 cm Coverage: Spreads well past the stand to hide cables and the water reservoir, and protects carpet or wood flooring from drips and resin
Deep Red Festive Colour: The rich tone sits well with green foliage, gold baubles and warm white lights and finishes the display at the base
Folds Flat for Storage: Lay it flat, spread the folds, close the opening with the bow, and pack it away with the decorations to reuse year after year
For Indoor Use

Add a sparkling festive touch to your seasonal decorations with this pack of 12 silver glitter Christmas tree picks, featuring 35 cm artificial leaf stems with flexible wired stems for effortless shaping and arranging. Designed to enhance Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, table centrepieces, floral arrangements, vases and festive displays, the shimmering glitter foliage catches the light beautifully to create fuller, eye-catching decorations. Each stem can be gently bent and positioned to suit your preferred display, making these decorative picks ideal for DIY craft projects, mantel arrangements, gift presentations and seasonal floral designs. Suitable for Christmas decorating as well as weddings, parties and special occasions, these versatile decorative sprays can be displayed on their own or combined with baubles, ribbons, flowers and greenery to create elegant festive arrangements throughout your home or event venue.
PACK OF 12 GLITTER LEAF PICKS: Includes 12 artificial walnut leaf Christmas tree picks in silver, each measuring 35cm long for adding colour, texture and fullness to festive displays.
FLEXIBLE WIRED STEMS: Bend, shape and position each stem to suit Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, floral arrangements and table centrepieces.
SPARKLING GLITTER FINISH: The decorative glitter-coated leaves catch the light to create an eye-catching festive effect in traditional or contemporary Christmas displays.
VERSATILE CHRISTMAS DECOR: Ideal for trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, mantel displays, centrepieces, gift presentations and seasonal floral arrangements.
IDEAL FOR FESTIVE CRAFTS: Use alone or combine with baubles, ribbons, flowers and greenery to create personalised Christmas decorations, party displays and DIY projects.

5096042276676.variantName: Christmas wreath - Christmas door wreath - Silver pine cones and hanging ribbon, flat reverse for a hallway or mantel - 42 cm
5096042276676.sourceDescription:
Silver pine cones make a textured ring with a flat silver back. Display it upright with the grey-silver ribbon provided, or lay it on a table around a small vase to bring the same finish into a centrepiece. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change. At 42 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

Let the ribbon carry the colour upwards from the wreath. Adjust the drop before making the final fastening and check that the arrangement hangs straight, particularly on a door with strong vertical panels. A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms. Choose one shade from your tree decorations for the hallway and repeat it in a small accent beside the wreath, letting the greenery carry the rest of the scheme.

For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs. When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side.

When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration.
Silver pine cones create a textured ring with a flat reverse for versatile display.
Includes a grey-silver hanging ribbon for easy upright presentation on doors or mantels.
Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, allowing flexible placement in hallways or entrances.
Compact 42 cm diameter design fits easily into smaller spaces without overwhelming the area.
Comes with Grey-silver ribbon
Hanging rope included

5096042277376.baseName: Christmas wreath frame - Coated wire floristry ring to arrange ribbon, flowers and greenery for door displays - Dark green, 40 cm
5096042277376.variantName: Christmas wreath frame - Coated wire floristry ring to arrange ribbon, flowers and greenery for door displays - Dark green, 40 cm
5096042277376.sourceDescription:
Dark green coated iron wire forms a 40 cm framework for fastening your own flowers, stems or foliage. The colour blends with greenery, a useful detail if part of the frame shows through a loose arrangement.

An open frame helps you control the finished outline while choosing exactly how much of it to cover. It gives trailing foliage, flowers or ribbon a defined edge, particularly useful when you want several pieces to follow the same design. For a traditional arrangement, build short bunches of foliage and lay them in the same direction around the ring. Overlap the ends as you work to cover the ties and keep the outer edge looking continuous.

Start by placing your decorative materials around the base without fixing them. Seeing the whole outline at once makes it easier to distribute large elements evenly and decide where a bow or main cluster should sit.

Dried flowers, ribbon and artificial greenery each give a different finish. Lay one sample of each against the base to compare scale before cutting lengths or making up several matching bunches. Make the first decoration a reference if you are planning a series. Note the width of the ribbon and the spacing between clusters, then use that guide to repeat the rhythm while varying the finishing colours.

For a table arrangement, try the outline on its chosen surface before decorating. Keeping the tallest pieces at one side lets you see the shape clearly and gives you room to fit the other table settings around it. If the wreath will be seen from the side, turn the base towards you as you build up the decorations.

At the end of the season, store the base and its decoration where the edges will stay uncompressed. If you like changing the design, removable ties make it easier to take off the top layer and plan a new arrangement.
Dark green coated iron wire frame blends with foliage for a seamless natural look.
40 cm floristry ring provides a defined edge for arranging flowers, ribbons and greenery.
Open design allows full control over the arrangement outline and decorative density.
Versatile seasonal wreath base suitable for Christmas door displays or wedding crafts.
Fittings & fixings not required

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.
